a: Meiosis creates genetic diversity and halves chromosome number for sexual reproduction.
Crossing over exchanges DNA between homologous chromosomes.
Dominant alleles mask recessive ones in heterozygotes.
Punnett squares predict genotype probabilities from crosses.
Pedigrees track traits across family generations.
Speciation is the formation of new species.
Fossils provide evidence of past life and change over time.
The carbon cycle moves carbon among atmosphere, organisms, and earth.
The nitrogen cycle converts nitrogen among usable chemical forms.
Carrying capacity is the population size an environment can sustain.
